Sir/Ma'am,

I am your constituent, living [location redacted]. I am writing to request your
assistance in reviewing a historic legal matter involving my family: *BP
Properties Ltd v Buckler (1987)*, relating to Great House Farm, Llandough.

My family lived on, cared for and claimed to own that farm for generations.
The events surrounding the 1987 case resulted in the loss of our home and
land, and left several members of my family deeply affected. Recent
research I have undertaken has revealed significant procedural
inconsistencies, historical irregularities, unanswered questions regarding
corporate identity, unverified service of key documents, and heritage
considerations relating to the site.

I have attached a short report summarising SOME of these issues. I am
requesting your help in identifying the appropriate bodies—legal,
historical, or governmental—who may be able to independently review the
historical record to ensure fairness, accuracy, and transparency.

My interest is not solely personal; Great House Farm has a heritage
significance to Wales, including documented accounts that Guglielmo Marconi
stayed there while experimenting with early radio technology. I believe
this should form part of our preserved historical record.

By way of background, I am a veteran and have served both in the Armed
Forces and recently with the Vale of Glamorgan Council. My intention is
simply to seek clarity, proper review, and justice where appropriate. I
would be grateful for your guidance on the correct avenues to pursue.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response.

Yours sincerely,
